title: Class-(K) counts on gadget surgeries are positive sums of sector partition functions
claim: for p odd, r | p - 1 and G = N x| C_r of class (K), on an r-surgery M whose triple product vanishes except on the permutations of one character triple S of product 1, where it is the gadget tensor of a multigraph Gamma (pattern {a, b, c} distinct: sum over edges of (x_u - x_v) (x) y_e (x) t_e; {s, s, s^-2}, s^3 != 1: sum of ((x_u - x_v) ^ p_e) (x) w_e; {s, s, s}, s^3 = 1: sum of (x_u - x_v) ^ p_e ^ q_e), |Hom(pi1 M, G)| = sum over k in Z/r of c_k lambda_k^n mu_k^m Z_{W_k}(Gamma), where c_k > 0, lambda_k, mu_k are powers of p computed from dimensions, and Z_{W_k} is the partition function of the positive, symmetric, translation-invariant weight W_k(xi, eta) = |K2(xi)| |K3(xi)| p^{-rank(eta o k23 on K2(xi) x K3(xi))} on U_k = B1 + A23*, built from the commutator pairings (k12, k13, k23) of the group with the action raised to the k-th power on the slot eigenspaces; W_k is constant exactly when its three pairings vanish, and a hard pair makes W_1 nonconstant, so the matrix [W_1(x - y)] has rank at least two.
failure_conditions: A random class-(K) group, pattern, sector and multigraph on which the direct count of the obstruction kernel from the abstract cohomology data differs from the template count or from the partition-function formula.
A weight W_k that is not symmetric, not positive, or constant while one of its pairings is nonzero, or nonconstant while all vanish.
A hard pair whose sector-1 weight matrix has rank one.
A small surgery and class-(K) group (not Heisenberg) on which the cohomological count formula differs from an independent count of lifts (cocycles to G/A, then the affine lifting system).
A disjoint union on which a sector term fails to be the product of the terms of its parts.
A control that cannot fail: with all pairings removed the weights must be constant.
foundation_claim_scope: Odd p with r | p - 1; manifolds whose triple product is a gadget tensor (realized in ticket C through COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001D section 3). Cited, not reproved: the count formula and graded components of COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001C sections 1-3, Poincare duality with local coefficients as in COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001B. No complexity claim in this ticket; no P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: the count formula against independent lifting counts (cocycles to G/A, then the affine lifting system by the group law) on 11 surgeries for four non-Heisenberg class-(K) groups, in every sector, also with kappa/2; on gadget models 1274 group-pattern-sector-graph cases where the direct obstruction count, the template count and the partition function agree (122 with nonconstant weights, all three patterns, sector 1 and others), 7 known values from the checkpoint and from COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001D, 170 hard pairs, 213 ranks, 934 negative controls, disjoint unions and the assembled formula; no human or external review
